_comment: Colours and labels for the AE territory map. Edit this, not build.py.
_groups_comment: Key = the AE names on a country, sorted, joined with ' & '. A country whose AE set matches a key gets that colour. 'label' overrides how the group is named in the legend (used for pools where the individuals don't split the region).
_fallback_comment: Colours handed out to any AE group that appears in Notion but is not listed above, so a new AE never breaks the build. The run warns loudly when one is used - add a proper entry here when that happens.
_legend_comment: Legend rows are people, not colours: an AE who owns two groups (Coen owns UK&I jointly and APAC alone) gets ONE row carrying both, so clicking it isolates everything they own. Order controls display order; anyone not listed is appended alphabetically.
_shared_suffix_comment: Appended to the region text of a person whose only groups are shared with someone else.
_expectations_comment: The build fails if reality drifts from these, so silent data loss is impossible. Update them deliberately when the database legitimately changes.

expectations._not_rendered_comment: In the database but with no polygon at this map scale. Informational; the build lists any additions.

_iso_fixes_comment: The database's Alpha-2 Code column has a few entries that are not valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, and three rows have no code at all. These are corrected on read so the join stays a pure code lookup. Fix them in Notion and these entries become harmless no-ops.
_unassigned_comment: Fill for a country with no AE in the database (disputed territories).
